method: upload a marker PDF via the API (distinctive content); poll POST /api/query for the marker question until the new document's own chunks appear in the sources list
rawOutput: VISIBLE after 80s from upload (3s after COMPLETED)
notes: Fresh vectors are searchable within seconds of job completion. Earlier observations of fresh documents not surfacing were caused by ranking dilution: vectors of TTL-expired jobs remain in the index and are filtered only AFTER top-K ranking, so a small new document can be out-ranked for generic questions until asked something document-specific.
